Dear Sir/Madam,

**RE: REQUEST FOR QUOTATION – PROCUREMENT OF CONTROL PANELS FOR PGCIL**

We are pleased to invite you to submit a competitive quotation for the supply of Control Panels as per the specifications outlined below. This procurement is being undertaken on behalf of **Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (PGCIL)** under the project titled **"Procurement of Control Panels"**.

---

## **PROJECT DETAILS**

- **Tender Reference Number:** GEM/2026/B/TEST_BROKEN
- **Procuring Authority:** PGCIL (Power Grid Corporation of India Limited)
- **Project Title:** Procurement of Control Panels
- **Procuring Agency:** Volks Energie

---

## **BILL OF QUANTITIES (BoQ)**

| S. No. | Item Description | Quantity | Unit | Technical Specification | Delivery Location | Required By Date |
|--------|------------------|----------|------|------------------------|-------------------|------------------|
| 1 | [NEEDS REVIEW: item_name] | [NEEDS REVIEW: quantity] | Nos | [NEEDS REVIEW: technical_spec] | [NEEDS REVIEW: delivery_location] | To be confirmed |

---

## **QUOTATION REQUIREMENTS**

Your quotation must include the following details for each line item:

1. **Unit Price:** Ex-works price per unit (in INR), clearly stating the base price exclusive of taxes
2. **GST Breakdown:** Separate itemization of CGST, SGST/IGST as applicable
3. **Total Price:** Inclusive of all applicable taxes and duties
4. **Lead Time:** Delivery schedule in weeks/days from the date of Purchase Order
5. **Payment Terms:** Proposed payment milestones and terms
6. **Warranty Period:** Standard warranty coverage offered
7. **Technical Compliance Sheet:** Point-by-point compliance statement against the technical specifications
8. **OEM Authorization:** Valid OEM authorization certificate (if you are an authorized partner/distributor)
9. **Delivery Terms:** Incoterms (FOB/CIF/DDP, etc.)
10. **Validity of Quotation:** Minimum 90 days from the date of submission

---

## **TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION REQUIRED**

Please submit the following technical documents along with your commercial quotation:

- Product technical datasheet and catalogues
- Compliance matrix mapping your offered product against the specified technical requirements
- Quality certifications (ISO/BIS/IEC or equivalent)
- Test certificates and type test reports
- Installation, operation, and maintenance manuals
- List of similar supplies to government/public sector undertakings (preferably PGCIL or similar utilities)

---

## **SUBMISSION GUIDELINES**

- **Submission Deadline:** [Insert Date & Time]
- **Submission Mode:** Email to [procurement@volksenergie.com] with subject line: "RFQ Response – GEM/2026/B/TEST_BROKEN – Control Panels"
- **Contact Person:** [Name, Designation]
- **Contact Details:** [Phone Number] | [Email Address]

---

## **EVALUATION CRITERIA**

Quotations will be evaluated based on:
- Technical compliance with specifications
- Competitive pricing
- Delivery timeline and reliability
- OEM credentials and past performance
- Quality certifications and standards compliance
- After-sales support and warranty terms

---

## **GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS**

1. All prices must be quoted in Indian Rupees (INR)
2. The quotation must be valid for a minimum period of 90 days from the date of submission
3. Conditional quotations will not be entertained
4. Volks Energie reserves the right to accept or reject any or all quotations without assigning any reason
5. No deviation from the specified technical requirements will be accepted unless prior written approval is obtained
6. The supplier shall be responsible for all risks until successful delivery and commissioning at the designated location

---

We look forward to receiving your competitive and comprehensive quotation at the earliest. Should you require any clarifications regarding the technical specifications, delivery requirements, or commercial terms, please feel free to contact us at the above-mentioned coordinates.

Thank you for your continued cooperation and support.

**Yours faithfully,**

**For Volks Energie**

[Authorized Signatory Name]
[Designation]
Procurement & Supply Chain Department

---

**Note:** This RFQ is issued subject to final confirmation of technical specifications and delivery locations. Any fields marked as requiring review will be communicated separately upon clarification from the procuring authority.
